enrollment_evidence_quote: Please review and sign enrollment services agreement via DocuSign.
phase_activation_evidence: Phase 1 is the activation, that's months 1 through 3 — your program begins, you'll typically see your first settlement offer, and your credit score may dip a bit as we stop payments to your enrolled creditors.
phase_traction_evidence: Months 4 through 9 is phase 2, traction. The groundwork is set so additional settlement offers come in, negotiations are actively underway, and your savings are being unlocked.
phase_momentum_evidence: Phase 3 is momentum, months 10 through 48 — that's the heart of the program where it all comes together. Accounts get resolved to a $0 balance, your enrolled debt is actively shrinking.
phase_graduation_evidence: By month 48 plus, that's graduation — your enrolled debts are resolved, the program is complete, and you move forward with a clean slate.
payments_mechanics_point_evidence: Your monthly funds don't go to Beyond Finance directly. They go into a dedicated savings account set up in your name, you can monitor it online any time. During the first few months, creditors may add late fees and interest — those are expected and already factored into your program cost so you end with a zero balance.
payments_withheld_point_evidence: We withhold payments because that demonstrates hardship to your creditors, which is required for them to negotiate. As a result, those creditors may close the enrolled accounts — that's normal and expected, it's how the program works.
violation_reason: Agent covered all four phases and both required discussion points.
